lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection and becomes progressively more compressed toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the upper terminal of the 9th stripe from the anterior; a secondary minor split is observable on the 4th stripe from the posterior near the dorsal line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated dashed segments and isolated white spots terminate the sequence posterior to the final continuous vertical line on the lower haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 4 distinct circular white spots is located on the lower haunch, positioned between the terminal vertical stripes and the posterior boundary of the torso.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three high-contrast spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking across the nasal bridge; two white circular spots on the cheek; white patch at the ventral neck junction; horizontal white bands on the lower limbs above the hooves.
